mechanics: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super obtained from the TP Medal Shop. It is a chargeable Galick Gun-like beam; unlike Galick Gun's hold-to-charge behavior, the player taps the assigned button to increase power. Current dedicated evidence lists a 9–15-hit, long-range beam. Exact charge timing, scaling, and frame data remain unresolved.
evidence_boundary: Numerical values are source-reported observations. Exact frames, universal scaling, hidden interactions, and reward probabilities are not asserted without direct evidence.
